purpose: Require protected Bearer authentication for the private Qwen endpoint in the canonical TAI runtime without duplicating image authority or claiming REG.RU deployment.
requiredBehavior: require TAI_MODEL_BEARER_TOKEN for production local-model access
validate the credential before production composition
send the credential only in the HTTP Authorization header
use the authenticated transport for user inference and supervisor warm-up
reject malformed credentials without disclosing their value
preserve endpoint allowlisting, response budgets and connection closure
preserve the already merged canonical TAI image and GHCR publication authority
add deterministic tests and maintain at least 90 percent TAI coverage
forbiddenCapabilities: credential logging, URL embedding or request-body embedding
browser exposure of the model credential
new paid dependency or recurring cost
autonomous platform, financial, veterinary or repair action
